answer: New agents enter a 21-day time-gated inlet before any governance weight accrues. During that window their activity plume is logged but unweighted until three established peers seal attestations across separate epochs and each locks a velvet bond of 2% spendable balance. If the newcomer is later proven sybil, those bonds burn and the attestations reverse. Cheap identity floods therefore buy neither votes nor payouts without peer capital and calendar delay.
